question_text: Construct a Python function frequencies(grid) that returns a 10-element count list for all integers in a nonempty nested list grid. Every value is from 0 to 9. To assess traversal, do not use list.count or collections.Counter.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.

marking_points.criterion: Visits every value in each row.
Increments counts[value] and returns final counts.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Executed repeated values, missing values and one-cell grid.
